headline: Wise vs PayPal for international
description: Compare Wise corridor fee estimates with PayPal international pricing for cross-border payouts—worked examples, FX pitfalls, and when each option wins.

mainEntity.name: Is Wise always cheaper than PayPal internationally?

acceptedAnswer.text: For many transfer corridors, Wise’s ~0.37–0.45% + fixed planning band beats typical wallet FX paths, but PayPal may still win as a collection tool. Compare the full path: collection + conversion + payout.
Not as a drop-in card wallet for every customer. Wise excels at transfers and borderless accounts; customer card checkout often still needs Stripe, PayPal, or similar.

mainEntity.name: What PayPal rate should I use for US domestic baselines?

acceptedAnswer.text: US Goods & Services list pricing commonly 3.49% + $0.49 as of 2026-10-15. International products differ—select the international schedule in /tools/paypal-fee-calculator/.

mainEntity.name: How do I estimate a Wise fee quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use /tools/wise-transfer-fee-calculator/ with the corridor estimate, and confirm the live quote on wise.com/pricing before sending large amounts.

mainEntity.name: Should freelancers invoice in USD or local currency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Invoice in the currency that maximizes paid invoices after fees and friction. Sometimes customer-local pricing converts better even if your FX cost rises—measure completion, then optimize rails.
